def x06_feature(app):

    assert invoke(app, record, sink) == 'logged'

    failed = r.X06Sink(fail=True)

class X06Sink:

        self.lines = []
        self.fail = fail

    def write(self, line):
        if self.fail:
            raise OSError('controlled log failure')
        self.lines.append(line)
